anomalies.description: A person in a white shirt appears to be concealing an item (possibly a green bag or product) under their clothing or against their body while standing close to another individual in the aisle; their posture and hand placement suggest deliberate concealment rather than normal browsing, consistent with shoplifting behavior.

original_descriptions.description: A person in a white shirt appears to be concealing an item (possibly a green bag or product) under their clothing or against their body while standing close to another individual in the aisle; their posture and hand placement suggest deliberate concealment rather than normal browsing, consistent with shoplifting behavior.

A person in a white shirt appears to be concealing an item under their clothing or in a bag while standing close to another individual in an aisle; their posture and hand placement near the waist/hip area suggest possible shoplifting behavior, consistent with the expected anomaly type.

A woman in a white top and green pants is seen reaching into a shelf, then repeatedly placing items into her waistband/pants area while facing away from the camera—consistent with concealing merchandise. A child in a white shirt stands close by, observing or assisting. The behavior aligns with shoplifting: secretive item concealment in clothing while browsing in a retail aisle.

A woman in a white top and green pants is seen reaching into a shelf display, then appears to conceal an item in her large black shoulder bag while bending slightly and shielding the action with her body. A second person in a white shirt stands close by, partially obscuring the view and possibly acting as a lookout. The behavior—reaching, concealing, body shielding, and proximity of accomplice—is highly consistent with shoplifting.

A woman in a white top and green pants is seen reaching into a shelf display, then deliberately placing an item into her open handbag while looking around furtively. Her posture and repeated glances suggest concealment behavior consistent with shoplifting. Another person in white is bent over nearby, possibly acting as a lookout or distraction. The actions occur in a retail aisle with no staff visible, increasing suspicion.

A person in a white top and dark pants appears to be concealing an item under their clothing or into a bag while browsing shelves; another individual (in green pants) stands close, possibly acting as a lookout. The behavior includes prolonged handling of items near the body, lack of interaction with store staff, and positioning that obscures hands from view—consistent with shoplifting.

A person in a white shirt appears to be concealing an item (possibly a small box or package) under their clothing or into a bag while standing close to another individual in an aisle; their posture and hand placement suggest deliberate concealment rather than normal shopping behavior. The timing and positioning align with typical shoplifting patterns—standing near shelves, using body to obscure actions, and no visible payment or basket.
